solutions.title: Two directional candy arrays
solutions.strategy: Compute the candy requirement from the left and from the right, then sum the larger requirement at each position.

timeComplexity.explanation: Three linear passes cover left requirements, right requirements, and summation.

solutions.title: One candy array with reverse correction
solutions.strategy: Fill left-to-right increases in one array, then scan right-to-left and raise entries that must beat a right neighbor.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each index is processed in the forward and backward scans.

spaceComplexity.explanation: One candy array stores the final assignment.
